## Tracked issue

<!-- Complete issue: Closes #123. Partial slice: Refs #123 or Part of #123. -->

Every change to `main` must arrive through an issue-linked pull request.
For a completed issue, include a supported closing reference such as `Closes #123`.
For a partial slice, include `Refs #123` or `Part of #123` naming an OPEN parent
issue in this repository. Keep the actual reference outside this comment and
code examples. A plain mention, a pull request number, or a cross-repository
reference does not satisfy the `linked issue` check.
